description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageService class within the OrangeHRM PIM module. It provides a service layer that manages access to EmployeeLanguageDao for operations related to employee languages, including lazy initialization of the Data Access Object.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageService
classes.description: Service class that manages the EmployeeLanguageDao for interacting with employee language data.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguageDao
methods.description: Provides access to the EmployeeLanguageDao instance, initializing it if it hasn't been created yet.
